mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 38 degrees with overcast conditions near Verona City Hall. While there is an ISS pass tonight, we will not be able to see it due to the clouds.

For city business, candidate packets are ready for the 2027 Spring Election, which features all four Aldermanic districts, with forms due January 5. Also, citizens can conveniently pay property taxes online using the BS and A payment portal.

There is plenty to do, with Yoga at Insight Wellness taking place today and ART House 360 open for their Thursday night series. Tomorrow, enjoy live music at Bailey's Run, a 50th-anniversary celebration at Wisconsin Brewing Company, and trivia at Hop Haus Brewing Co. later tonight.
Verona officers remained active over the last report period, including making an O W I arrest on November 1st.
The restaurant is currently closed for the night. We look forward to seeing you tomorrow at 10:00 AM when we will be serving Snickers Swirl as our flavor of the day.
